parameters.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unpaid' AND due_date < NOW() THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as overdue, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) as paid_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'unpaid' AND due_date < NOW() THEN 1 END) as overdue_count, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM expenses WHERE status = 'approved' AND expense_date >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month')) as total_expenses FROM invoices WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month')
